title: [ RPG Maker MZ ] Pets - Add Companions with Gift System, Happiness, and Leveling Up!

posts.author: slayer2
posts.body:
PETS
[RPG Maker MZ] Pets - Add Companions with Gift System, Happiness, and Leveling Up!
Would you like to add pets that accompany your characters and bring unique gifts? This plugin makes it possible! Convert any actor with the <pet> tag into a pet with a happiness system, gifts, and level-up mechanics. Additionally, you can customize its behavior, animations, sounds, and more.
Features:
​
Happiness and Leveling System:
By feeding your pet, its happiness increases. When it reaches 100%, it levels up, and happiness resets to 0, ready to grow again!
With each level, the chance to find rarer items increases, depending on the chosen configuration.
Customizable Items and Gifts:
Configure the items the pet can find, their appearance rates, and whether the probability increases with the pet's level.
Set random times between gifts, the maximum number of gifts within a set time, and cooldown periods to prevent constant gifting.
Create Items to Feed the Pet:
Create custom items as food for the pet
by using the tag <petsX> (e.g., <pets10>) in the Notes field of the item in the database.
When using these items, the pet's happiness increases according to the value of X.
If feeding is enabled
, by feeding the pet:
The hunger state is deactivated
, and the pet resumes finding items for the player until it gets hungry again.
The feeding timer is reset.
Custom animations and sounds configured in the plugin are played.
If not fed within the configured time
, the pet displays an animated balloon showing hunger and stops moving and giving gifts until it is fed again.
Animations and Sounds:
Customize animations for happiness increase, leveling up, and the sound played when finding an item.
Configure animated balloons to indicate when the pet is hungry.
Intelligent and Random Movement:
The pet follows the player as a party member but can also move randomly within a configured area when the player is idle.
The distance between the player and the pet affects its movement and following behavior.
Optional Feeding System:
Enable or disable the need to feed the pet.
If feeding is active, the pet will stop giving gifts and stay still when hungry, displaying an animated balloon as a warning.
Limitations and Warnings:
​
This plugin is in its
version 1.0
.
It has not been tested with more than one pet in the party or with other followers.
It is recommended to test it before using it in advanced projects.
How to Use:
​
Set Up the Actor as a Pet:
In the database, add the tag <pet> in the Notes field of the actor you want to use as a pet.
Configure Plugin Parameters:
Customize items, animations, timings, sounds, follower distances, and feeding settings.
Happiness System:
Create items as food
for the pet using the tag <petsX> (e.g., <pets10>) in the Notes field of the item in the database.
Using these items increases the pet's happiness according to the value of X.
When happiness reaches 100%, the pet levels up, increasing its ability to find rarer items.
Movement and Gifts:
The pet follows the player and, when idle, moves randomly within the configured area.
Gifts are given randomly and according to the settings, respecting the set timings and limits.
